mentions.name: ReFocused
mentions.description: An all-in-one productivity app that consolidates a Pomodoro timer, a secure journal, and habit tracking into a single clean, fast interface with a minimalist UI. It is a full-stack app with a Next.js 15 frontend and a FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, live and free to use.
mentions.problem: The author was frustrated with paying for and switching between 8+ different apps for a Pomodoro timer, a secure journal, and habit tracking, and wanted to consolidate everything into one clean, fast interface.
mentions.audience: General consumers; the author describes it as an app anyone can use
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on ReFocused (https://refocused.app), an all-in-one productivity app.
